pairs.subject: knowledge-registry
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/knowledge/index.tsx:44 The view only shows runtime knowledge patterns and agent memories from demo fixtures or Supabase (via useKnowledgeData). A search of the context directory for registry, catalog, contributor, digest, overlay, manifest, lane and propose found nothing, so this context is not a shared, multi-consumer knowledge repository and the subject's precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/knowledge/useKnowledgeData.ts:13 Data comes from a mock API or Supabase rows. There is no generated index or digest that consumers could use to check whether their copy is current.

src/components/dashboard/views/knowledge/useKnowledgeData.ts:15 The view reads per-user synced patterns. It is not a second consumer of a shared registry, so the overlay question of whose fact a field is does not come up.
